items.title: Post #19 — Reggie Rivers 8-step paddle raise
items.copy: donor relationships gala ask, Converge Reggie Rivers paddle-raise 8-step system, open with one story not the annual report, easy yes first, line up your champion, make it we not I, finish line, show momentum, honor the guest never shame, right next step, donor conversation

items.title: Post #12 — Generosity relocated
items.copy: giving dollars grew 5% donor participation declined fifth year, Fundraising Effectiveness Project, generosity didn't shrink it relocated, donor-advised funds workplace matching giving circles, donor privacy inboxes, donor behavior trends, where have our donors moved

items.title: Post #4 — Fundraising is a team sport
items.copy: fundraising is a team sport, development office gift officers annual fund events, chief development officer in the room when CFO shapes the budget, data lead donor experience, org charts weren't drawn for that reality, nonprofit CEO transitions record levels 2025, fundraising runs through every department

items.title: Post #6 — Segment for relevance not ideology
items.copy: donors sorting themselves by politics, Edelman Trust Barometer 7 in 10 reluctant to trust different values, mission as center pole of the tent, segment for relevance not ideology, giving history event attendance volunteer hours, retire the proxies age geography party registration, donor segmentation

items.title: Post #23 — Partnership not urgency
items.copy: fundraising engagement doesn't make donors feel responsible, urgency guilt fear short term, invite donors into the mission, belonging, donors want to know their support matters, trust that leads to the next conversation, donor stewardship retention

items.title: Post #2 — Ideas from outside the sector
items.copy: best ideas rarely stay confined to one sector, strategies from e-commerce customer journeys, healthcare patient loyalty donor stewardship, SaaS re-engage inactive customers donor reactivation, journey mapping personalization retention audience segmentation lifecycle engagement, cross-vertical learning
